newsitem.title: GERMANY: CHS to take over German Frank&Walter - paper.
newsitem.headline: CHS to take over German Frank&Walter - paper.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc, a U.S. distributor of microcomputer products, is to take over German computer wholesaler Frank & Walter Computer GmbH, German newspapers reported on Tuesday.

Dailies Handelsblatt and Sueddeutsche Zeitung said the current owners of the German group would receive a package of CHS stock worth $37 million for Frank & Walter, which has annual sales of some 1.1 billion marks ($707.5 million).
Handelsblatt said the transaction would create a group with sales of more than two billion marks, dislodging Computer 2000 AG from its position as Germany's largest computer wholesaler.
CHS already has German business with sales of some 975 million marks, Handelsblatt said.
CHS has just completed a purchase of Merisel Inc's European and Latin American business, including its German unit.
The deal would make Frank & Walter founder Carsten Frank, who is to head CHS's European business, CHS's second largest shareholder, Handelsblatt said.
